test_title: PYST 1: SSC Stenographer - English (Held on: 11 Nov 2021 Shift 1 )
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

The gardener pruned all the rose bushes.

options.text: All the rose bushes were pruned by the gardener.
All the rose bushes was pruned by the gardener.
All the rose bushes are being pruned by the gardener.
All the rose bushes have been pruned by the gardener.

solution:
The correct answer is: **All the rose bushes were pruned by the gardener.**
